name: Project Liberty
mission: Build a premium, rights-respecting media platform with excellent discovery, playback quality, reliability, and extensibility.

agentBus.description: GitHub-transported handoff between the GPT and Claude lanes. Removes the human relay. The `fromAgent` field is self-asserted and is NOT authenticated: any principal with write access to this repository can publish a message claiming any agent identity. The control plane enforces that the CLAIMED reviewer is the designated one and is not the implementer, but cannot prove authorship.
notProvided: protection against a malicious peer holding the same GitHub credential
hardenedModeRequires: separate GitHub App or service identities per lane
pull requests required for bus directories
CODEOWNERS covering both bus directions, and CODEOWNERS itself protected
agentBus.note: CODEOWNERS alone is not a security control. It only has effect when branch/ruleset enforcement actually requires the pull-request and code-owner-review path.

operatingPrinciples: maximize safe parallelism rather than raw agent count
require explicit quality evidence before DONE
route architecture and high-leverage review work to the best-suited reasoning agent
route local execution and repository-integrated implementation to the best-suited coding agent
escalate only decisions that genuinely require the project commander
